description: This file defines an abstract class for processing leave-related email notifications within the OrangeHRM system. It includes methods for retrieving email subscribers, recipients based on roles and supervision hierarchy, leave details, and comments, utilizing various services and traits specific to the HRM context.

classes.name: AbstractLeaveEmailProcessor
classes.description: An abstract class providing common functionalities for handling leave email notifications, including retrieving recipients, leave details, and comments, leveraging dependency injection and internal services.

methods.name: getLeaveRequestCommentService
methods.description: Lazily instantiates and returns the LeaveRequestCommentService.

methods.name: getSubscribersForEvent
methods.description: Fetches email subscribers for a specific notification ID.

methods.name: getEmployeesWithRole
methods.description: Retrieves employees with a specified role in relation to a given employee.

methods.name: getSelf
methods.description: Returns the email recipient for the employee themselves.

methods.name: getSubscribers
methods.description: Gets email recipients based on predefined email event names.

methods.name: getSupervisors
methods.description: Retrieves supervisors of a given employee.

methods.name: getLeaveDetailsByDetailedLeaves
methods.description: Generates detailed leave information from an array of detailed leave objects.

methods.name: getLeaveRequestComments
methods.description: Fetches comments associated with a specific leave request.
